supporting_observations.claim: At 13:37 UTC, tess.hart launched Remote Desktop targeting DC-ORC-01, and WS-THART-01 opened a TCP connection to that host on port 3389. The supplied records contain no account-management event identifying the creator of guest.rwong or its group membership.

Who created the account and whether that action was authorized.
Whether guest.rwong was added only to Volunteers or granted administrator or other privileges.

Whether guest.rwong was subsequently used to access systems or data.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-ORC-01 account-management and authentication logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, especially events identifying account creation, group membership changes, enablement, and the initiating subject.
Verify guest.rwong's current and historical group memberships, privileges, creation metadata, and account activity against the help-desk temporary-account procedure.
Obtain RDP server-side logs for DC-ORC-01 around 13:37 UTC to determine whether tess.hart's connection succeeded and what session activity followed.
Confirm with the help desk or change records whether tess.hart was tasked with creating guest.rwong at that time.
